source_archive.archive_note: Supplied ZIP is a macOS repack with __MACOSX entries. Archive README identifies Caldera PLM.ZIP and records a BDOS-only difference. Original upstream ZIP hash has not been independently verified.

source.normalization: none; original CR/LF and source bytes retained

supplementary_manual.title: ED: A Context Editor for the CP/M Disk System, User's Manual
supplementary_manual.edition_evidence: Cover and copyright page say copyright 1976, 1978; no numbered edition is asserted
supplementary_manual.role: Earlier historical background, not evidence that a feature belongs to CP/M 2.2

known_discrepancies: Archive ED.COM is 6,563 bytes; stock disk ED.COM is 6,656 bytes and has 3,025 differing bytes in the common prefix. Differences are not just trailing padding. Source/binary behavioral equivalence remains to be qualified.
Supplied HTML manual ZIP has a third-edition September 1983 index, but its ch2.htm is a web challenge page rather than the ED chapter; do not use it as a chapter reference.
No latest-revision claim is made; the selected CP/M 2.2 source and stock oracle define the implementation baseline.
